Students are strongly encouraged to consult an academic advisor to ensure they meet all degree requirements for their intended baccalaureate program. Helpful Resources: CSUB Catalog Transfer Admission Requirements Academic Advising Student Centers CSUB Program Pathways Mapper Course Equivalency Information for 4-Year Institutions Students and staff can explore course transfer equivalencies through the Transfer Evaluation System (TES) . notes.contentHtml:
Articulation Agreement Overview

This agreement outlines lower-division course requirements specific to the major. Students are strongly encouraged to consult an academic advisor to ensure they meet all degree requirements for their intended baccalaureate program.


Helpful Resources:

  • CSUB Catalog
  • Transfer Admission Requirements
  • Academic Advising Student Centers
  • CSUB Program Pathways Mapper


Course Equivalency Information for 4-Year Institutions

Students and staff can explore course transfer equivalencies through the Transfer Evaluation System (TES). Equivalency agreements are updated regularly and subject to change. For the most current information, please refer to TES or contact the Articulation Office.

notes.content: The Bachelor of Science Degree in Kinesiology at CSUB covers a broad knowledge base that represents several disciplines that include physical activity leadership, clinical exercise science, personal training and allied health professions. Students majoring in Kinesiology have three concentrations to choose from: Applied Exercise Science, Physical Activity Leadership and Allied Health. The Kinesiology department also offers a minor in Kinesiology and a variety of activity courses that provide recreation and fitness opportunities for all CSUB students. For additional information, visit the following: Department of Kinesiology Program Requirements - Kinesiology, BS, Concentration in Allied Health
notes.contentHtml:
The Bachelor of Science Degree in Kinesiology at CSUB covers a broad knowledge base that represents several disciplines that include physical activity leadership, clinical exercise science, personal training and allied health professions. Students majoring in Kinesiology have three concentrations to choose from: Applied Exercise Science, Physical Activity Leadership and Allied Health.


The Kinesiology department also offers a minor in Kinesiology and a variety of activity courses that provide recreation and fitness opportunities for all CSUB students.


For additional information, visit the following:

Department of Kinesiology

Program Requirements - Kinesiology, BS, Concentration in Allied Health

notes.content: A modification to the standard GE program has been approved that allows the possibility of satisfying some GE requirements through the major. Please see the Kinesiology General Education Requirements in the CSUB catalog for further information. Students who have taken Biology or Chemistry coursework should check the Articulation Agreement by the Department of the respective community colleges. The agreement may articulate differently, and it may determine whether the entire Biology and/or Chemistry sequence needs to be completed to receive appropriate course credit for the major requirements at CSUB.
notes.contentHtml:
• A modification to the standard GE program has been approved that allows the possibility of satisfying some GE requirements through the major. Please see the Kinesiology General Education Requirements in the CSUB catalog for further information.
  • Students who have taken Biology or Chemistry coursework should check the Articulation Agreement by the Department of the respective community colleges. The agreement may articulate differently, and it may determine whether the entire Biology and/or Chemistry sequence needs to be completed to receive appropriate course credit for the major requirements at CSUB.
